assets.prompt: The square pillar cracked: a crack zig-zagging down its shaft, one at its capital's corner and one at its plinth. Drawn at 2x detail (two art pixels a world unit, drawn at half size in the game) for a top-down pixel game, about its 1x silhouette, size and frames, part by part, each a rod, a ball, a bevelled box or polygon, a barrel's drum, a column or a heap: lit from the top-left in three shades of its material, the base the most, with its material's surface where it has one (wood grain and boards, bone and stone pores, water streaks, a flame's bright core, rivets, a glint in the material's own light shade), a dark seam where a part lies over another and a one-pixel dark outline round the outside. Palette colours from docs/STYLE.md only; no player colours; every pixel fully clear or fully opaque.
